brief:
# URGENT: approval links answer 'Method not allowed'

Brett's words: "When I click approve, it says method not allowed. You can't have it broken."

Pending build: 'URGENT: approval links say Method not allowed' (tick its steps via the orchestrator).

## Problem
Approval links sent in notices, AmberX push, the console banner and axHub tool results (approvalUrl = https://axhub.amberxai.com/auth/admin/approvals/<id>) answer 'Method not allowed' when Brett taps Approve. The hub's plain HTML approval pages were removed when every axhub.amberxai.com route moved to the axhub-web app (apps/axhub-web), so the old link/form hits a route that no longer accepts it. The axHub repo itself may need the fix; if so, say exactly what to change there.

## Do
1. Find every place that builds approval links (console approvals-banner, lib-approvals, notify/AmberX push, axhub-web routes) and the hub's decide API (approve/deny).
2. Make the link open the approval in axhub-web (or the console) with Approve and Deny that call the decide API with the correct method and close/confirm.
3. Keep the old /auth/admin/approvals/<id> URL working (redirect to the new view).
4. Test Approve and Deny end to end on a veto hold and a confirm hold.
5. Short report, commit, stop so it can be landed with build_land. Keep it small and fast.
